content.title: TENB Q3 Deep Dive: Exposure Management Momentum and Platform Expansion Drive Results
content.summary: Cybersecurity exposure management company Tenable (NASDAQ:TENB) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 11.2% year on year to $252.4 million. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $251.1 million, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.42 per share was 13.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
